Unclear technical justification: Loss function combination (Eq. 11) with multiple weights lacks principled motivation; why these specific terms and weights? Missing design space exploration

Strong practical contribution: achieves one-step SR with 5.3-11.4× inference speedup while maintaining superior quality compared to multi-step methods
Thorough ablation studies examining individual components (CiD vs CiDA, VAE dimensions, loss terms) with detailed analysis of design choices
Well-executed system integration combining SD2.1-VAE16, consistent score identity distillation, and adversarial training into an effective pipeline
